worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.summary: Whips sharp leaves into a vortex that rolls along the aim line, shredding whoever it actually passes and bursting at the end of its range; the recoil harshly lowers the user's Sp. Atk. The maelstrom form rolls slower and can cut through several foes, at the cost of single-target power and a slower cast.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.use.1: Maelstrom form: roll through a whole line of foes at once
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.use.2: Catch the target and the foes behind it in the same vortex
Whips a leaf vortex out along the aim line, dealing about %1$s special damage to each foe it actually rolls over.
Range %1$s blocks; the column travels at %2$s blocks/tick, radius %3$s blocks.
Once the leaves leave, the user's Sp. Atk drops %1$s stage(s), hit or miss; the drop lasts through the fight and fades after combat.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.maelstrom.on: Maelstrom form: the storm keeps rolling along the line at a slower speed, cutting through up to %1$s foes (once each) before bursting at the end of its range.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.maelstrom.of: Piercing form: a faster blade bursts on the first foe it meets, heavier and quicker, but it does not roll past.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.timing: Range %1$s blocks; wind-up %2$s s, recovery %3$s s, costing %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s s.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.growth.0: From level %1$s the storm power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.growth.1: From level %1$s the storm power rises to %2$s and the range to %3$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.preference.m: On: wind speed x0.62, the storm keeps rolling along the line and cuts through up to several foes (once each) before bursting at the end; costs single-target power x0.85, wind-up +3 ticks, cooldown +6 ticks. Good against lines. Off (piercing): a faster blade bursts on the first foe, heavier and quicker, for single targets.
worldcombat.skill.leafstorm.preference.a: Beyond this distance the user closes in first. Larger opens the storm from farther away.
On: targets with more foes lined up behind them rank higher, so the rolling storm cuts a whole line; off: ordinary ranged ordering.
world_combat.move.leafstorm.text.miss: The vortex whiffs and the leaves scatter
